description: This file defines a MessageEnhancer class that provides functionality to enhance messages using AI, including context extraction and telemetry capture. It imports external modules and interfaces related to messaging, telemetry, and configuration.

classes.name: MessageEnhancer
classes.description: Provides static methods to enhance messages with AI, extract task history, and capture telemetry.

methods.name: enhanceMessage
methods.description: Enhances a message prompt using the configured AI provider, optionally including task history.

methods.name: extractTaskHistory
methods.description: Extracts relevant recent messages from ClineMessage array for context.

methods.name: captureTelemetry
methods.description: Captures telemetry data related to prompt enhancement, including whether task history was included.
